formula_description: composite = (quality^wQ * durability^wD * performance^wP) * 10, where each axis is 0-10 scale, weights sum to 1.0

calibration_products.name: TOTO Neorest NX2
calibration_products.notes: TOTO's flagship smart toilet. TORNADO FLUSH + CeFiONtect + integrated Washlet. Japan manufacturing (Kitakyushu). High-fire china (>1200°C). Dual-flush 1.0/0.8 GPF. Plumber consensus: best toilet made. Proprietary parts dock on durability offset by exceptional build quality. Integrated bidet + deodorizer + auto-flush + heated seat.
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Global market leader in sanitary ware, independent public company, vertically integrated manufacturing, 107-year history.

calibration_products.name: TOTO Ultramax II (MS604124CEFG)
calibration_products.notes: TOTO's one-piece workhorse. TORNADO FLUSH + CeFiONtect. 1.28 GPF WaterSense. MaP 1000g. Plumber #1 recommendation for residential install. High-fire china, fully glazed 2-1/8" trapway. SoftClose seat included. Better durability ecosystem than Neorest (standard parts more accessible). USA manufacturing (Morrow GA).
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: US manufacturing in GA, strong parts availability through plumbing supply houses.

calibration_products.name: Kohler Highline Arc (K-5310)
calibration_products.notes: Kohler's best-selling toilet. AquaPiston canister flush valve = 360° water entry, no flapper degradation. Revolution 360 swirl rinse. MaP 1000g. Two-piece construction (cosmetic/gasket dock vs one-piece). CleanCoat glazing. Excellent parts — Fluidmaster universal fill valve, AquaPiston is Kohler proprietary but widely stocked. #2 plumber preference. Kohler WI HQ, mix of US and Mexico manufacturing.
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Private family-owned, 150+ year history, diversified (plumbing, engines, hospitality), no going-concern risk.

calibration_products.name: American Standard Champion 4 (2586.128ST)
calibration_products.notes: The workhorse. 4-inch piston flush valve (largest in residential) = fastest water delivery. MaP 1000g consistently. EverClean antimicrobial glaze (silver-ion). Two-piece, standard china. Excellent MaP performance but standard construction quality. Fully Fluidmaster-compatible parts. 5-year mechanical warranty (best in mid-tier). Lixil parent (also owns INAX, Grohe). Plumber consensus: 'good enough for a quality bathroom.'
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Lixil Group (public, Japan — owns American Standard, Grohe, INAX)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Lixil is diversified global. No quality degradation reported post-acquisition. Parts ecosystem strong.

calibration_products.name: Gerber Viper (21-014)
calibration_products.notes: Plumber value pick. MaP 800g (PREMIUM). Standard 3" flapper but consistent. Standard glaze (no proprietary coating). Fully Fluidmaster-compatible. Easy DIY repairs. Gerber (Spectrum Brands) — US manufacturing. Professional plumbers recommend for budget-conscious quality installs. 'Consistent flush, cheap parts' per plumber forums.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Spectrum Brands Holdings (public, diversified consumer products)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Spectrum Brands diversified. Gerber plumbing is a solid mid-market brand.

calibration_products.name: Glacier Bay Elongated HD (Home Depot)
calibration_products.notes: Home Depot house brand. Builder-grade baseline. MaP ~500g (spotty data, often below PREMIUM 600g threshold). 2" flapper (smallest standard, most frequent replacement). Thin-wall china (cracking reports from plumbers). No special glazing. Partially glazed trapway. Unknown OEM manufacturing. Universal Fluidmaster parts = only durability bright spot. Plumber consensus: 'most service calls for clogs/valve failures.'
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Home Depot exclusive brand (manufactured by undisclosed OEM, likely Foremost/Globe Union)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Home Depot backing ensures availability. Quality is what it is — budget positioning.
